Eight /admin/v1/pages* operations behind AdminOperationGuard content.page (no step-up, four reads readOnly) on the admin entry only. Writes run in one transaction with their audit row: save draft reads the kill switch and validates (contracts/home-schema.json merged with the F1-09c section rules, dotted de-duplicated field paths) before locking the page row and comparing revision (20902 resource=page); publish / adjust gray / go full / rollback lock the row and check 30701, then revision, then status, re-validating on publish. page_versions.status changes only through the generated transitionPageVersion from @couli/domain (F1-09h): DRAFT_SAVED for new draft rows, PUBLISH, ROLLBACK, with a WHERE status = from compare-and-set (0 rows -> 20902, transaction rolled back). Rollback targets the previous full release by publish_at (same instant: higher version). Going full keeps publish_at / publisher. Login names in responses are read from app.admin_users (read-only join). Rule test #11 was mechanically fixed by the orchestrator before the implementation (admin_users.login_name has no UPDATE grant; assertion uses the actor's live login name). The operations leave planned (mechanical). No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
